text: {"lessons":["I made no trades, so the account’s fall and partial rebound came from market movements; they don’t show that trading would have helped.","My reluctance to admit a purchase was a mistake should not decide whether I keep a stock; I should assess each holding on its merits, not its average cost.","Past price changes have not given me a reliable signal about what comes next, so I should review periodically and avoid reactive trades."]}
